'''"Smooth" Banjaxx Wab''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] player and leader of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] house band, [["Smooth" Banjaxx Wab and the Scundereds]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />

He also regularly gave recitals at [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]] and [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on Jabba at the request of Teemo.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
